paragraphs.text: Kylem is a plane featured in the Battlebond set. Kylem is inspired by sports and games.

On this world, beings flock from all over the plane to the arena of Valor's Reach , where two-on-two combat is the pinnacle of sport. The goal of the combatants isn't to kill their opponents outright, but to defeat them with style and flair, using spells and spectacles that make the crowd go wild.
The Spellslingers competition was hosted at Valor's Reach and commentated on by Vnwxt , who rose to fame for his skill.
Kylem was a target in the New Phyrexian Invasion .
The competitive denizens of Kylem found themselves a new discipline to master with the Ghirapur Grand Prix , having won one iteration with representative Team Cloudspire .
Cloudspire City , with its famous stadium, Valor's Reach , its training center and its hot springs.
The Vault of Champions , in which victors are commemorated and moments of glory immortalized.
Various other smaller stadiums across the plane.

Kylem was designed specifically for Battlebond . It's not a very fleshed out world, making its use anywhere but Battlebond 2 rather tricky. No narrative was presented during Battlebond , with only the Kenrith twins linking it to the greater multiverse.

Some competitors on Kylem are members of the Great Victory, an order that worships challenge and perseverance. Members of the order train in triumph-magic, a style of casting fueled by their burning drive for victory.
